state.task: Improve optional semantic complexity judgments beyond static complexity counts.
state.observed_failure: In five synthetic examples, flat versus nested readability differed by only 0.05 and flat versus a six-case chained ternary by 0.02 on a 0-3 scale. Indirection and missing context were detected.
state.proposal: Score maintenance tracing burden: pending guards, conditional binding and helper hops. Add separate boolean judgments for whether guard-clause flattening or expanding conditional expressions improves local maintenance under the stated constraints. Preserve useful natural nesting, simple ternaries, and invariant-protecting helpers. Never change static measurements or fabricate semantic scores.
state.validation_plan: Keep original score-gap expectations unchanged; freeze independent fixtures before testing. Include natural loops, simple ternaries, compact named predicates, and useful helper controls. Check behavior first. Retain failures, distributions and provenance. Treat a synthetic suite as regression coverage, not proof of general value.

criteria.more_extreme_nesting: A larger number of nested independent guards with larger static complexity.
criteria.repeat_same_case: Repeat the existing easy flat classifier without changing its task or constraints.
